changeSet.author: Artem Prokudin
changeSet.sql: update interaction set reasonings = cast(replace(replace(cast(reasonings as char), '"lawName":', '"knowledgeName":'), '"appliedLaws":', '"appliedKnowledge":') as json) where reasonings is not null;

rollback.sql: update interaction set reasonings = cast(replace(replace(cast(reasonings as char), '"knowledgeName":', '"lawName":'), '"appliedKnowledge":', '"appliedLaws":') as json) where reasonings is not null;
